summary: Iteration 5 full regression: backend 23/23 passed, frontend nav refactor + new /baskets page + shared HamperCard verified end-to-end. All 3 reported bugs are fixed. Zero overflow across 55 public datapoints (11 widths x 5 pages) and 8 admin datapoints (1024px admin overflow fix confirmed). Full checkout flow succeeded (ref UF1027, cart cleared), admin login + enquiries dashboard works, TEST data cleaned up.
verified_fixes: BUG1: nav-baskets now navigates to /baskets (not /). baskets-page renders with heading 'Curated Gourmet Baskets', 4 filter chips, 6 hampers, home-page testid absent.
BUG2: nav-home added as first nav link, navigates to /, active-state correct (Home active on /, Baskets active on /baskets).
BUG3: nav-custom-builder, nav-gift, nav-corporate ALL absent on desktop AND mobile-nav-panel. Only Home/Baskets/Fruits present in both.

Baskets page: filter-corporate narrows to 1 card; deep link /baskets?curation=corporate pre-selects chip + filters grid; add-cart-{slug} increments cart-count (0->1); order-now-{slug} opens cart-drawer; card link -> /hampers/{slug}.

Link rewiring: curation-royal/citrus/tropical/green all point to /baskets?curation={id}; footer Farm Origins/Cold-Chain -> /baskets, Corporate Gifting -> /baskets?curation=corporate; hamper detail pill row has Home(/), Baskets(/baskets), Fruits (Custom)(/fruits); empty cart drawer Browse -> /baskets; checkout success Back to Baskets -> /baskets; /hampers/does-not-exist shows hamper-not-found with back -> /baskets.
Full checkout flow: 1 hamper + 1 fruit -> name/phone -> enquiry-ref UF1027 -> cart cleared; enquiry visible in /admin/enquiries.

Responsiveness: 0 overflow across widths [320,375,390,414,768,820,1024,1280,1366,1440,1920] on /baskets, /baskets?curation=corporate, /, /hampers/royal-exotic-basket, /fruits. Admin /admin/inventory and /admin/customers overflow-free at 1024/1280/1440/1920 (1024px admin overflow fix verified).
note_on_testids_in_request: Review request referenced testids like 'add-cart-urbanfruto-shop', 'order-now-urbanfruto-shop', 'shelf-add-urbanfruto-shop', 'related-hamper-urbanfruto-shop' - these appear to be preview-domain-placeholder artefacts; the real HamperCard uses add-cart-{slug} / order-now-{slug} with the 6 real hamper slugs (royal-exotic-basket, etc.). Verified with real slug 'royal-exotic-basket'. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Shared HamperCard component is a clean DRY refactor used by both Home.jsx and Baskets.jsx - good.
AdminLayout main column min-w-0 + overflow-x-hidden correctly resolves 1024px admin overflow.
Baskets.jsx deep link via query-string correctly pre-selects filter chip (verified).
